title: Repair sparse span index rotation causing missing tenant metrics and dashboard blanks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Several tenants (hosted/dedicated/private) reported intermittent missing spans and blank dashboard tiles during a production incident. Root cause traced to the span index rotation/compaction pipeline which accidentally advanced segment pointers for low-volume tenants, making recent spans unreachable to the console query path. This ticket covers the hotfix, short-term backfill, and long-term compactor safeguards.
impact_summary: Between 2026-03-01 22:10 UTC and 2026-03-02 04:30 UTC, 12 dedicated tenants and 27 private deployments experienced missing tracing data and blank live-panel tiles. Several customers escalated to SE/AE; one enterprise customer reported inability to validate SLO breaches during incident window (billing/ops impact).
root_cause: The compaction job's rotation algorithm incorrectly treated sparse span segments with low token counts as stale when a watermark race occurred between segment sealing and the shard-mapper update. This resulted in the segment pointer being advanced without migrating the segment index to the active index store. Console queries that joined timeseries->span_index then returned empty results for affected time windows. The bug is a race in compactor.go:rotateSegments() when shard state transitions overlap with async seal notifications.
steps_to_reproduce: Run local compactor with synthetic low-volume tenant (single span/minute) and trigger a shard topology update during compaction window.
Observe compactor log: 'segment sealed' followed by 'rotation confirmed' without corresponding 'index migrated' entry.
Query the console live-panel for the tenant; tracing JOIN returns empty set while raw span storage still contains events.
timeline: 2026-03-01 21:55 UTC - First SE report: tenant dashboard tiles blank; customer attaches trace IDs present in raw store but absent in console.
2026-03-01 22:30 UTC - Incident declared, obs oncall paged; triage points to span index path returning 0 hits for affected tenants.
2026-03-01 23:10 UTC - Reproduced locally with race harness; temporary route applied to bypass compactor rotation on suspected shards.
2026-03-02 01:45 UTC - Hotfix deployed: disable aggressive rotation for segments with under-aggregation threshold and enable conservative pointer commit.
2026-03-02 03:00 UTC - Backfill job started to re-index orphaned segment pointers for impacted tenants.
2026-03-03 09:00 UTC - Backfill completed for priority tenants; customer confirmations received for affected enterprise accounts.
2026-03-09 11:20 UTC - PR created with compactor race fix and additional metrics and tests (see related_prs).
2026-03-12 14:00 UTC - Integration tests green; rolling canary started in hosted region eu-west-1.
mitigation_actions: Hotpatch: disable rotation for segments flagged low-volume until compactor guard is released (deployed 2026-03-02 01:45 UTC).
Backfill: run reindex job that re-attaches orphaned segment pointers to active index store; prioritized VIP tenants first.
Customer comms: SEs emailed affected customers with timeline, interim mitigations, and ETA for permanent fix.
Dashboard fallback: enable temporary live-panel fallback to raw-span-scan path for windows where index lookup returns empty.
permanent_remediation: Fix rotateSegments() to use two-phase commit for pointer advancement: order of operations ensures index migration completes before pointer advance.
Add compaction transaction log and recovery replay so incomplete rotations are detected and repaired automatically on restart.
Introduce compactor invariants and unit/regression tests that simulate watermark races and low-volume segment behavior.
Add alerting: create SLO-backed alert when span_index join selectivity drops below threshold for >5m across N tenants.
Update runbooks with explicit steps to detect 'orphaned segment pointer' state and run the backfill safely.
tests_added: race_harness_test.go - simulates shard topology update overlapping compaction window (unit).
compactor_integration_test.py - end-to-end test that validates pointer migration under low-volume churn.
e2e-observability-regression.yaml - CI workflow to run compaction regressions on postsubmit for compactor package.
rollout_plan: Canary: deploy patch to hosted eu-west-1 with 5% traffic and synthetic smoke checks (24h).
Staggered rollout: expand to remaining regions over 48h pending no regression alerts.
Dedicated/private: ship hotfix package for private appliance v1.8.2; coordinate with SEs for on-prem upgrades and provide upgrade playbook.
Post-deploy: re-run backfill for any late-joining tenants and validate dashboard/trace continuity.
